scripts.test:fixtures: cd src-tauri && UI_FIXTURES_DIR=../tests-ui/.fixtures cargo test --quiet --test ui_fixtures
scripts.test:ui: npm run build && npm run test:fixtures && playwright test -c tests-ui/playwright.config.mjs
scripts.screenshots: npm run build && cd src-tauri && UI_DEMO_DIR=../tests-ui/.fixtures cargo test --quiet --test demo_fixtures && cd .. && UI_FIXTURES=demo.json SCREENSHOTS=1 playwright test -c tests-ui/playwright.config.mjs screenshots && (command -v pngquant >/dev/null && pngquant --quality 85-98 --speed 1 --force --ext .png ../../docs/screenshots/*.png || true)
